success_criteria: All package manifests parse and contain expected target versions.
Dependency installation completes for all eight npm package directories.
Source files no longer contain removed APIs: uuid.v4 object calls, mongo.GridStore, new (winston.Logger), and csv.parse().from.path.
Entry modules listed in the ImpactReport can be required or smoke-tested without module load errors.
Any retained deprecated package risk is documented by the executor.
Generated dependency-upgrade smoke test passes with Node built-in test runner.
Generated tests confirm all eight package manifests parse and core dependency targets match the upgrade plan.
Generated tests confirm high-risk source migrations no longer use removed uuid, mongodb GridStore, winston Logger, socketio-jwt authorize, or csv from.path APIs.
Generated tests confirm Dublin Core XML and Primo archive export paths retain expected generation/finalization calls.

plan_summary: Update all reported npm manifests to latest observed versions, then make targeted compatibility edits for major-version API breaks in uuid, mongodb, Socket.IO, winston, nodemailer, csv, xmlbuilder, archiver, sharp/send, Express/body-parser, and related callback-based modules.
rollback_strategy: Revert the single final execution commit created by the executor.
planning_notes: Loaded the full ImpactReport and treated it as authoritative. Inspected package manifests and targeted source snippets/call patterns around reported locations; larger files were inspected with targeted rg searches rather than full-file reads. Planned source changes are limited to affected files from the ImpactReport. Deprecated packages request, fluent-ffmpeg, gc-stats, ftp, optimist, and pace are not replaced with different packages unless install/runtime validation forces documented scope expansion.
